title: A CONTROLLER CAN EQUIP A GUN FROM THE STASH
why: In the Undercroft stash, a gun from the welcome pack or from a raid is an item. There are only two ways to make it your gun: the right-click item menu (openItemMenu, wired by menuable on the contextmenu event) and the Equip as your gun button on the stash detail row, which is built in the cell's onmouseenter. A controller can use neither. padFocusables reaches the stash cell, but A on it is a detail-0 click that the v14.74 handler turns into packing one. No pad input fires contextmenu or mouseenter. Even a menu the mouse opened stays out of the pad's reach: padOpenModal never returns the .imenu (it hangs off document.body, outside #hub), padFocusables has no selector for its .imenurow divs, and B clicks CLOSE on the Stash screen behind it. So player 2 on a pad can only pack his gun into the backpack. P.equipped stays empty and every raid issues him the loaner, while the loaner line tells him to equip his gun from the stash. This hits any pad-only player with a gun item in the stash, which is every new profile, because the welcome pack equips nothing.
